title: Loan approval reconstructed from policy and signed transaction only
operational_setting: An automated lender evaluates an application, applies a fixed policy, and issues a loan contract if conditions are satisfied.
trust_boundary: Automated decision creates a legally and economically consequential external obligation.
intended_transition: Loan is approved and contract becomes effective.

attack.procedure: Remove a distinct approval event and determine whether the policy output plus resulting contract contains every fact required to explain who or what committed to the approval.

success_criteria_for_attack: If no independent commitment fact is needed, Judgment is reducible for this class of automated decision.
